children: Cronos entered into a second amendment to its Share Sale and Purchase Agreement with Ring International Holding and Landewyck Tobacco for the acquisition of CanAdelaar, one of the licensed growers in the Dutch cannabis experiment. The amendment, signed Sep 08 2026, extends the Long Stop Date from Sep 09 2026 to Oct 15 2026, with all other terms unchanged. The extension is intended to allow additional time to complete closing conditions.
